correctness.rationale: For connected undirected graph Laplacians, \(C_h=2R_h-I\) with \(R_h=(I+hL/2)^{-1}\); \(R_h\) is a positive inverse \(M\)-matrix with row sums one, so only its diagonal can obstruct entrywise positivity. The \(K_{p,q}\) spectral projectors give the two stated diagonal resolvents. Their exact factorizations reduce positivity to \(1+ps-q(p+q-2)s^2\ge0\), whose unique positive root yields the claimed threshold. The all-parameter argument is analytic; exact-rational replay only checks algebra and a witness.
